target.statement: CT feature-construction time of 3.656 s on Car at L=256 (and the ~7x speedup vs CT-Hash at 25.691 s)

compute.basis: Tiny UCR sequences (n<=2000), pure CPU string algorithm; the main cost is installing the repo, downloading UCR data, and re-running the L-sweep for Car/Beef/PigCVP, which the paper reports as seconds per run.

blockers: Repo may not ship the exact CT-Hash baseline or the L-sweep driver script
UCR archive download and train/test concatenation must be replicated
Exact timing numbers are machine-dependent; only the qualitative speedup trend is robust
title: CT-Miner: Fast and Coarse-Grained Time-Series Pattern Mining via Cartesian Trees
